reconstruction_priority: tactile handmade material authenticity — thick chunky wool cardigan loops, raw frayed linen flower petals, and porous clay skin — AI typically renders smooth digital plastic or generic illustration
downcast facial expression with round tortoiseshell glasses and oversized elongated bulbous nose — AI often distorts glasses geometry or normalizes the nose
razor-sharp macro focus on the tiny linen flower and articulated clay hands — AI frequently blurs fine finger joints or fails to connect the needle pin
dramatic lighting separation between the brightly illuminated foreground craftwork and the deep velvety charcoal background — AI often washes out the background with unwanted flat lighting
